name: contact-people
title: Contact People
description: A grid of person cards with role, languages, an email to copy and an optional booking link, filtered by team.

props.name: labels
props.type: { all?: string; filter?: string; copy?: string; copied?: string; failed?: string; book?: string; languages?: string; shown?: (n: number) => string }

a11y.text: A section named by its h2 with a list of people; each is an article with an h3 name and role. Languages are a list named "Languages". When there is more than one team a Pills radio group from chart-kit (label "Team") filters, and "{n} people shown" is announced in a role="status" region.

The copy button shows a word that is aria-hidden and is named "Copy email: {email}"; the result is announced in a role="status" region. The initials are aria-hidden unless an avatar is passed. "Book a call" adds the name in hidden text.
Pills arrows move between teams, with Home and End; buttons and links are native.
The press feedback on the buttons is dropped under reduced motion.
